sources.title: OPUS-MT — CTranslate2 4.8.4 documentation - Machine Translation
sources.snippet: OPUS-MT OPUS-MT contains a collection of 1000+ pretrained models. Since the models are Transformer models trained with Marian, they are compatible with CTranslate2. The Marian guide also applies for these models, but a separate converter is provided for convenience:

sources.title: GitHub - rozdaybeda/ct2_translator: Lightweight C++23 command-line ...
sources.snippet: Lightweight C++23 command-line translator that runs Opus-MT and Meta's NLLB-200 models entirely on CPU via CTranslate2. Features int8/float32 quantization, SentencePiece tokenization, beam search, per-line language-pair overrides in interactive mode, and reports throughput (tok/s) after each translation - rozdaybeda/ct2_translator
